user.title: Add an aquarium
user.description: Enter the internal aquarium dimensions. Volume will be calculated automatically from length × width × water depth.

data_description.tank_name: A friendly name such as Main Aquarium.
data_description.temperature_entity: Choose your aquarium temperature probe if it already exists in Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: An aquarium with this name is already configured.

init.title: Aquarium options
init.description: Configure the remote fish library, GitHub editing, water-test notifications, backup heater, lighting schedule and CO2 automation.

data.co2_off_before_end_min: CO2 stop before main lights end

data_description.species_library_url: Use the Raw GitHub URL to fish_library.json. The last valid copy is cached and refreshed every 24 hours.
data_description.backup_heater_switch: Choose the Home Assistant switch entity for the second heater.
data_description.backup_heater_automation_enabled: When enabled, Aquarium Manager manages the backup heater using the aquarium temperature probe and the safety settings below.
data_description.backup_heater_on_temp_c: The temperature must stay below this threshold for the configured delay before the backup heater turns on.
data_description.backup_heater_off_temp_c: The backup heater turns off when the aquarium reaches this temperature. This must be higher than the ON threshold.
data_description.backup_heater_low_delay_min: Prevents short temperature dips from starting the backup heater.
data_description.backup_heater_max_runtime_min: Fail-safe maximum continuous run. Reaching it turns the heater off and locks automation until the water recovers to the OFF temperature or the integration is reconfigured/restarted.
data_description.github_token: Fine-grained token for the fish-library repository with Contents: read/write. Used only by Home Assistant to commit reviewed species; it is never exposed on the dashboard.
data_description.light_1_switch: Choose the Zigbee plug for the first aquarium light.
data_description.light_2_switch: Choose the Zigbee plug for the second aquarium light.
data_description.co2_switch: Choose the Zigbee plug controlling the CO2 solenoid/generator output.
data_description.lighting_automation_enabled: Calculates the full, half, blue and CO2 schedule from the lights-on time and main photoperiod duration.
data_description.lights_on_time: Start of the main plant-lighting period. Enter as HH:MM, for example 12:00.
data_description.light_duration_hours: Total main plant photoperiod. The final half-light period is included inside this duration; blue light is added afterwards.
data_description.half_light_duration_min: How long before the end of the main photoperiod to switch both lamps from full to half light.
data_description.blue_light_duration_min: Optional blue viewing period after the main photoperiod. CO2 is always off during blue mode.
data_description.co2_lead_min: CO2 pre-charge before the main lights. Default 120 minutes.
data_description.co2_off_before_end_min: Stops CO2 before the end of the main photoperiod. Default 60 minutes.
data_description.light_mode_toggle_seconds: Your lamps change Full → Half → Blue by a quick plug OFF/ON cycle. This is the pause used for each cycle.
data_description.water_test_notify_entity: Choose a notify entity for NH3, NO2 and NO3 timer-complete alerts. If left blank, Aquarium Manager creates a persistent Home Assistant notification instead.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL.
error.heater_required: Choose a backup heater switch before enabling automation.
error.temperature_required: An existing aquarium temperature sensor is required for backup-heater automation.
error.off_must_exceed_on: The OFF temperature must be higher than the ON temperature.
error.lighting_switches_required: Choose at least Light 1 before enabling lighting automation. Light 2 and CO2 are optional.
error.lights_must_differ: Light 1 and Light 2 must be different switch entities.
error.half_exceeds_duration: The half-light period cannot be longer than the main photoperiod.
error.co2_off_exceeds_duration: CO2 cannot be scheduled to stop more minutes before lights-out than the whole photoperiod.
error.invalid_time: Enter a valid time as HH:MM, for example 12:00.
